item.title: Despite the Sistine Chapel, Michelangelo Did Not Consider Himself a Painter
item.description: The problem with being a Renaissance man is that your favorite skill may not be as in-demand as your least favorite skill. Michelangelo was uniquely talented in all aspects of art: design, drawing, sculpting, and painting. He considered himself a sculptor foremost, but when the pope commissioned him to paint a fresco on the ceiling of the Sistine Chapel at the Vatican, he couldn't refuse (although he tried). item.title: Scientists Discover Fossilized Anus
item.description: They say that, like opinions, everyone has one of these. But anuses are rare in the fossil record. Anuses generally do not survive the ravages of time. But, the New York Post reports, paleontologists found a fossilized anus dating back 300 million years.They found the anus in a Thuringian Forest in Germany. item.title: What Hypnosis is Really About
item.description: The term hypnosis grew out of the work of Franz Mesmer in the 18th century. He promoted the theory of animal magnetism and would cure illness with magnetic fluids. His successes were later attributed to the power of suggestion, which eventually gave us both the placebo effect and the concept of hypnosis. item.title: Pediatricians: A Gold Mine of Antibodies
item.description: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is so common that almost all children are infected before the age of two. There are vaccines and therapies have been developed from the antibodies produced by people who have had RSV, but they aren't effective against all the many strains of RSV. New research in China is looking at a population of people who may have a better range of antibodies- pediatricians. item.title: "Africa," But This Time It's Really Africa!
item.description: There are 54 countries in Africa (plus three disputed territories), more than any other continent. item.description: In grade school, we learn that St. Augustine, founded in 1565, is the US's oldest permanent city settled by Europeans. item.title: What To Do With Your Big Lottery Jackpot
item.description: The odds of winning millions of dollars in a lottery are very, very small, and are only slightly improved by buying a ticket. But people do win.
